newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SINCLAIR ON MISCONDUCT CHARGE FOR DROPPING SHORTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SINCLAIR ON MISCONDUCT CHARGE FOR DROPPING SHORTS.

text.p: Chelsea defender Frank Sinclair was charged with misconduct on Wednesday by the English Football Association for dropping his shorts after scoring in a 3-2 defeat by Coventry.
Sinclair scored Chelsea's first league goal of the season on Saturday and celebrated with a brief jog with his shorts around his knees.
A F.A. spokesman said Sinclair had two weeks to seek a personal hearing.
